==== tluaMetatableCallSuspend.tlua (5 errors) ====
    // A suspend __call pairs the same way a sync one does: the receiver drops out, and the call
    // carries the coroutine contract, so only a suspend context may invoke it.
    
    local execute = suspend function(query: string): table[]
      return {};
    end;
    
    // The assign form.
    local sqlAssigned = setmetatable({}, {
      __call = suspend function(self: table, query: string): table[]
        return execute(query);
      end,
    });
    
    // The statement form, mutating in place. The receiver picks up its type from the __call slot.
    local sql = {};
    setmetatable(sql, {
      __call = suspend function(_self, query: string)
        return execute(query);
      end,
    });
    
    // Own members survive next to the call surface.
    local api = { begin = function(self: table): number return 1; end };
    setmetatable(api, {
      __call = suspend function(self: table, query: string): table[]
        return execute(query);
      end,
    });
    
    suspend function use(): void
      local rows: table[] = sqlAssigned("SELECT 1");
      local rows2: table[] = sql("SELECT 1");
      local n: number = api.begin(api);
      local rows3: table[] = api("SELECT 1");
    end
    
    // The contract holds through the pairing: a sync context may not invoke a suspend __call.
    function syncUse(): void
      local rows = sql("SELECT 1");
                   ~~~
